summary.text: Veronica Gonzalez, a Republican and Conservative Party Lower East Side-raised community advocate, small-business owner and Republican district leader who had not previously held elected office, lost the November 3, 2026 election for New York State Assembly District 74 to incumbent Keith Powers.

paragraphs.text: Gonzalez was born and raised on the Lower East Side of Manhattan, and Our Town reports that she has lived in her Manhattan neighborhood for over two decades.
She describes herself as a community advocate, Republican district leader, small business owner and author, and Our Town described her as running for office for the first time.
Gonzalez says she has spent decades doing nonprofit-partnership and community-outreach work, including donating backpacks and school supplies and helping secure direct assistance for NYC families.
She also says she has assisted NYCHA tenants with apartment-repair backlog issues and has received the President's Volunteer Service Award and a Presidential Lifetime Achievement Award.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Gonzalez lost to Keith Powers, according to unofficial results from the NYC Board of Elections and Wikipedia.
